description: A false-colour satellite image depicts a landscape featuring a mosaic of agricultural fields, scattered settlements, and a riparian zone. Dense vegetation, particularly along the river in the lower portion of the image, appears in shades of bright red, indicating high chlorophyll content typical of healthy biomass when displayed with a Near-Infrared (NIR) band mapped to red. Agricultural fields show diverse colours ranging from bright red to turquoise and blueish-grey, reflecting different crop types, growth stages, or bare soil. Several small, irregularly shaped areas containing clusters of buildings and associated infrastructure are highlighted by yellow polygon outlines and labelled "1110". These labelled areas correspond to "Continuous Urban fabric" (Class 1.1.1) as defined in the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines. The image resolution is 2.5 metres, derived from a Spot 5 satellite using a 1/2/3 band combination (Green/Red/NIR). The data is sourced from CNES 2011©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image.
